news.title: Bullish Tops Revenue Estimates, Losses Deepen Amid Crypto Downturn
news.summary: Bullish  braved a trading slowdown to post higher-than-expected revenue in the second quarter even as swings in the fair value of its cryptocurrency holdings caused its losses to deepen.  Subscriptions and services revenue—a category including anything other than core transaction fees, from CoinDesk event revenue to margin loans—grew to a “record” $62.7 million from $32.9 million in 2025.  Digital asset sales, a measure of revenue generated from executing crypto spot transactions on the exchange, fell to $32.6 billion from $58.6 billion last year.
